data.name: Alleyn
data.gender_notes: Alleyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'alee' meaning rock, Alleyn represents a strong and stable foundation. In Christianity, it can symbolize Christ as the cornerstone of one's faith. The name Alleyn carries the meaning “Little Rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alleyn usually hope their child will grow to embody little rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Alleyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Rock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alleyn total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אלין
in_hebrew.meaning: אלין הוא שם שפירושו האל הוא אלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלין הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשם אליעזר, שפירושו 'האל הוא אלי'. השם אליעזר מוזכר בתנ"ך כבן של אברהם ונעשה שם פופולרי בקרב היהודים. הנוצרים אימצו את השם ונתנו לו משמעות רוחנית, הקושרת את הנושא לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Αλέιν
in_greek.meaning: Αλέιν σημαίνει Ο Θεός είναι ο Θεός μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Αλέιν είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Αلیهזר (Aleinazar), που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο Θεός μου'. Το όνομα αυτό έχει τις ρίζες του στην εβραϊκή παράδοση και χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην Καινή Διαθήκη. Οι Χριστιανοί το υιοθέτησαν και το συνδέουν με την πνευματική σχέση με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Alleyn
in_latin.meaning: Alleyn significat Deus est Deus meus
in_latin.long_meaning: Alleyn est forma latina nominis hebraici Aleinazar, quod interpretatur 'Deus est Deus meus'. Nomen hoc origines habet in traditione judaica et a Christianis adoptatum est, qui ei significationem spiritualem attribuunt, coniungentes cum Deo.

in_english.name: Alleyn
in_english.meaning: Alleyn means God is my God or noble friend
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Alleyn originates from the Hebrew name Aleinazar, meaning 'God is my God'. It has been adopted into various cultures, symbolizing a strong spiritual connection to God. Historically, the name has been associated with nobility and divine friendship. In Christian tradition, Alleyn represents faithfulness and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alleyn has a rich history rooted in European culture, specifically in England. It is believed to have originated from the Norman-French surname 'Alain' or 'Alein', which also means 'rock' or 'handsome'. The name gained popularity among the Anglo-Saxon communities and eventually spread to the English-speaking world. Alleyn is also associated with Sir Edward Alleyn (1566-1627), an English actor and benefactor, who founded the famous Dulwich College and made it one of the greatest charitable foundations in England.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Alleyn can be seen as a representation of Christ as the foundation of our faith. It serves as a reminder that our faith should be strong and unwavering, like a solid rock. Additionally, in the Bible, there are several instances where 'rock' or 'foundation' is used as a metaphor for God, such as in Deuteronomy 32:4 and Isaiah 28:16. Therefore, Alleyn can also be interpreted as a reflection of the divine presence and strength in one's life.
